author: Sega Jenesis
title: Looking for digital artists for Pokémon binder scenes
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. If you’re an artist or know someone who might be interested, please send them my way! I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability. Contact via DM on Threads.
